Name: Unbroken Forest Quest Items
Author: ncarigon
Description:
Do you use a mod that changes items' categories? Are your hot peppers now vegetables? Are your dandelions now flowers? Maybe your tomatoes are now fruit. If so, those changes can cause a certain woodland friend to request items that you can no longer produce, breaking the quest.

This mod fixes that potential issue by ensuring the needed item processing is still available for all potentially requested items.

The following changes are made:

[list=1]
[*]A generic input trigger is added to the dehydrator, using the "dehydratable" context tag.
[*]A generic input trigger is added to the fish smoker, using the "smokable" context tag.
[*]For each potentially requested item, the relevant context tags from "dehydratable", "smokable", "preserves_jelly", "preserves_pickle", and "keg_juice" are added, based on the original item category.
[*]Exclusions are added to Preserve Jar inputs to ensure proper Jelly or Pickle processing.
[*]Exclusions are also added to Keg inputs for Juice or Wine processing, but Wine is never requested so the "keg_wine" context tag is not actually added to anything.
[/list]
Those changes ensure that hot peppers can always make jelly, dandelions can always be pickled, etc.

Compatibility tested with the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38755]Produce Category Swapper[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38755][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27038]Vegas' Better Item Categories[/url]
[*]a few local overrides that I use
[/list]If you are not using any mods that alter item categories, this mod will provide no functional differences.
